title: Yoga landing page, edited directly
spec: Claude Design. AI builds the page twice. The user edits the design directly twice and sets the direction. Building is shared.

messages.content: Make a landing page for a small yoga studio in Tromsø. Calm colours, lots of white space, one clear booking button.

I built a one-page layout: hero with a soft sage background and the headline 'Breathe in the north', a class schedule grid, three instructor cards, and a single 'Book a class' button in the hero. [used tool: create_design - Yoga studio landing page]
[user edited the design directly] changed the headline to 'Stillness under the northern lights' and moved the booking button below the schedule
Now make the pricing section match the style of my edits: same font size for headings, and put the button at the bottom like I did.
I added a pricing section with three cards (drop-in, 10-class card, monthly) using your heading size, and placed the booking button at the bottom, matching your layout. [used tool: update_design]
[user edited the design directly] changed the monthly price to 890 NOK and removed the 10-class card
